clauses.clause: {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card.
clauses.evidence: Every [activate [0]] variant: 'card becomes tapped (by card/TAP)', 'you draws you:Library 5#1', then 'ask one_of: [you_spare, you_trick, you_land_drop, you_cast_spell, you_cast_creature, you:Library 5#1]' (your whole hand INCLUDING the card just drawn, so the draw comes first), and exactly the picked card goes hand -> graveyard; the variant picking the drawn card discards it. No mana spent.
clauses.issue: The discard selector is ONE_OF where the compiler's B3-seq-draw-discard writes CHOOSE; for a discard from your own hand both ask you for exactly one card (verbs.py MOVE_ZONE hand branch), so play is identical.

clauses.clause: {2}{U}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice this creature: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
clauses.evidence: 'ability [1] target slot: 1..1 of [you_fallen]': only the creature card in YOUR graveyard (not you_used, a non-creature, nor opp_fallen in the opponent's graveyard). [activate [1] targets=['you_fallen']]: 'card becomes tapped', 'card moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/SACRIFICE)', mana B-1 U-1 W-2 (= {2}{U}{B}), 'you_fallen moves graveyard -> battlefield', P/T 2/2. Tree is the canonical B5c-cost-ub-sacrifice-return.
